verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships a server and a library, so API stability and deprecation are fair questions for this product. The evidence pack never mentions API versioning, stability guarantees or a deprecation policy. Pre-built release binaries and the server listing do not amount to a versioned API contract, and a community note that vision support was once removed points away from a formal deprecation process.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
